## Summary

What does this pull request change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation / planning document
- [ ] Hardware or mechanical documentation / design files
- [ ] Firmware
- [ ] Host tooling
- [ ] Models / evaluation / model card
- [ ] Dataset templates / metadata schema
- [ ] Repository configuration (templates, `.gitignore`, `.editorconfig`, CI)

## Related issues

Closes #...

## Checklist

### Content and honesty

- [ ] No unsupported claims: nothing is described as built, measured, functional, or trained unless it is
      and the evidence is in the repository.
- [ ] Incomplete work is marked `Status: Planned`, `Status: Placeholder`, or `TODO`.
- [ ] No fabricated measurement data, test results, or metadata rows.
- [ ] No third-party copyrighted material (datasheets, schematics, images, text).

### Repository hygiene

- [ ] No large binaries, raw recordings, raw audio, trained model binaries, build outputs, or IDE caches.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private keys, `.env` files, local absolute paths, or personal data.
- [ ] New files are non-empty and have meaningful content.
- [ ] Markdown links resolve; CSV headers are unchanged or the change is documented.
- [ ] Source files (if any) carry the `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` header; Markdown files do not.

### Safety

- [ ] The change does not weaken guarding, emergency stop, speed limiting, or the "device never
      controls the motor" principle (see `docs/safety.md`).

### Verification

Describe how the change was verified (build, tests, link check, review). For firmware: SDK version and
board target. For tooling: Python version and test command. For documentation: review performed.

## Screenshots / diagrams (optional)

Exports of changed diagrams or screenshots (no personal data).
